name: luchuirp_warrior
description: a Luchuirp Warrior, a stout gnome fighter: a bushy red beard, a brown leather cap with brass-rimmed blue goggles on top, bare muscular arms, a teal tunic with a brown leather apron hung with tools and a brass-buckled belt, brown boots, a thick wooden club bound with brass bands in his RIGHT hand, and a round bronze shield with a brass cogwheel emblem on his LEFT arm
hands: the brass-banded club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the round bronze shield stays on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the brass-banded club is lifted beside the head with its heavy end pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the brass-banded club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the round bronze shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the brass-banded club is level, its heavy end pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the brass-banded club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the shield arm with the round bronze shield swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the brass-banded club carries on down until its heavy end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the red beard trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the brass-banded club comes back up on the near side toward its raised ready angle, the round bronze shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the round bronze shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the brass-banded club dipping, the round bronze shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the round bronze shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops into the red beard, the brass-banded club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the heavy end of the brass-banded club resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the brass-banded club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the leather cap and goggles still on his head; the brass-banded club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round bronze shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round bronze shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the brass-banded club and the round bronze shield on the ground beside him
